name: United Club
notes: not_found: United Club is a members/day-pass airport lounge with all-inclusive complimentary food (breakfast buffet, lunch/afternoon buffet with soups, salads, sandwiches, cheeses, snacks, desserts) and complimentary standard beer/wine/spirits included with entry -- no per-item menu prices are published anywhere. Only premium top-shelf liquor and wine carry an extra charge, and no priced list of those was found; this matches the playbook's explicit 'lounge with all-inclusive food' not-found example.

name: Meraki Café
notes: DoorDash marketplace listing (server-rendered schema.org Menu JSON-LD, not the order.online white-label) with address matching the work list exactly (1735 Adams Avenue, San Diego). 59 dishes across 11 sections (Coffee, Not Coffee, Signature Drinks, Fresh Smoothies, Artisan Sandwiches, Breakfast, Bagels, Small Plates, Avocado Toast, Acai Bowls, Salads) reads as a complete cafe menu. Markup test on the ~11 non-whole-dollar prices found no consistent divisor. A SinglePlatform listing (places.singleplatform.com/meraki-cafe-0/menu) carries lower prices on overlapping items (e.g. Classic Acai $7.00 vs $10.00, Fresh Mozzarella sandwich $7.50 vs $11.00, Arugula Greek Salad $8.00 vs $11.00) at an inconsistent ratio (1.33x-1.47x) rather than a clean single markup factor -- per playbook this reads as SinglePlatform being a stale, restaurant-submitted, years-old price sheet rather than DoorDash carrying a fee, so SinglePlatform was not used as crossCheckedAgainst. Own site (merakicafesd.com) is a client-rendered GoDaddy builder page with no static menu content, and its Square Online ordering storefront (merakicafesd.square.site) fetches its catalog client-side with no prices in static HTML or __BOOTSTRAP_STATE__ -- would need a browser.
